subject: ipc
source: International Primary Curriculum (IPC), Milepost 1 thematic units (science, history, geography, society) — Fieldwork Education; aligned with England National Curriculum KS1 science

weeks.topic: Brainwave: how our brains learn and grow
objectives: Learn that the brain helps us think and learn
Discover that practice makes our brains stronger

weeks.topic: Brainwave: being a good learner — IPC personal goals
objectives: Talk about the personal goals (e.g. resilience, cooperation)
Set a learning goal for the term

weeks.topic: Toys: our favourite toys and how we play
objectives: Describe a favourite toy
Sort toys by how we play with them

weeks.topic: Toys: old and new — how toys have changed
objectives: Compare toys from the past with toys today
Order toys on a simple timeline

weeks.topic: Toys: asking grandparents about the past
objectives: Ask questions about toys from long ago
Learn from what older people remember

weeks.topic: Toys: materials toys are made from
objectives: Name everyday materials: wood, plastic, metal, fabric
Sort toys by material

weeks.topic: Toys: pushes and pulls — how toys move
objectives: Explore how pushes and pulls make toys move
Describe movement using fast, slow, stop

weeks.topic: Toys: designing and making a moving toy
objectives: Design a simple moving toy
Make it and test whether it works

weeks.topic: Seasons: the four seasons and their weather
objectives: Name the four seasons
Describe typical weather in each season

weeks.topic: Seasons: São Paulo and the UK — wet and dry seasons
objectives: Compare seasons in São Paulo and the UK
Learn about the rainy summer in Brazil

weeks.topic: Seasons: measuring and recording the weather
objectives: Record daily weather with symbols
Measure rainfall with a simple rain gauge

weeks.topic: Seasons: dressing for the weather
objectives: Choose suitable clothes for different weather
Test which material keeps us dry

weeks.topic: Seasons: how plants and trees change through the year
objectives: Observe a tree in the school grounds
Describe changes in leaves and flowers

weeks.topic: Seasons: festivals and celebrations through the year
objectives: Learn about festivals in different seasons
Share how my family celebrates

weeks.topic: Review: Toys and Seasons units
objectives: Revisit materials, pushes and pulls
Revisit the seasons and weather

weeks.topic: Flowers and Insects: parts of a plant
objectives: Name roots, stem, leaves, flowers and petals
Label a plant diagram

weeks.topic: Flowers and Insects: what plants need to grow
objectives: Plant seeds and observe them growing
Find out that plants need water, light and warmth

weeks.topic: Flowers and Insects: minibeast hunt in the school garden
objectives: Find and name minibeasts in different habitats
Record what we find in a tally

weeks.topic: Flowers and Insects: the life cycle of a butterfly
objectives: Describe the stages egg, caterpillar, chrysalis, butterfly
Order the stages of the life cycle

weeks.topic: Flowers and Insects: bees and pollination
objectives: Learn how bees help flowers
Explain why bees are important for food

weeks.topic: Flowers and Insects: looking after habitats
objectives: Build a bug hotel for minibeasts
Talk about how we can protect habitats

weeks.topic: Holidays: where we go — beach, mountains, city
objectives: Describe different holiday places
Sort places into human and physical features

weeks.topic: Holidays: using maps and a globe
objectives: Find land and sea on a globe
Use a simple map with a key

weeks.topic: Holidays: packing a suitcase
objectives: Decide what to pack for different places
Explain my choices

weeks.topic: Holidays: holidays in the past
objectives: Compare holidays long ago and today
Look at old photographs for clues

weeks.topic: Holidays: postcards from the seven continents
objectives: Name the seven continents and five oceans
Find Brazil and the UK on a world map

weeks.topic: Mid-year assessment: Toys, Seasons, Flowers and Holidays
objectives: Name parts of a plant and a butterfly life cycle
Use a map and name continents
Sort materials

weeks.topic: Animals: sorting animal groups
objectives: Sort animals into mammals, birds, fish, reptiles and amphibians
Describe their features

objectives: Sort animals by what they eat
Make a simple food chain

objectives: Find out about jaguars, toucans and capybaras
Locate the Amazon and Pantanal on a map

objectives: Explain what pets need to stay healthy
Talk about being responsible for animals

weeks.topic: Ourselves: exploring the five senses
objectives: Name the five senses and the body parts we use
Test our senses with simple activities

weeks.topic: Ourselves: parts of the human body
objectives: Name and label basic parts of the body
Play games to remember body parts

weeks.topic: Ourselves: keeping healthy
objectives: Talk about healthy food, exercise and sleep
Explain why we wash our hands

weeks.topic: Ourselves: growing up — from baby to child
objectives: Order human life stages
Compare what babies and children can do

objectives: Sort animals into groups and by diet
Name body parts and the senses
Explain how to stay healthy

weeks.topic: Year 1 review: my IPC learning journey
objectives: Share favourite learning from each unit
Reflect on my personal goals
